  context={"endpoint"}
>

Retrieve a Corporation by id with indexer-computed aggregates (controlled_ecosystems, participant role counts, trust-deposit snapshot) and CGF versions. Aligned with VPR MOD-CO-QRY-1. When the At-Block-Height header is supplied, the whole Corporation is reconstructed as of that block (404 if it did not exist yet).
